_readme: Authored content for Batch trees_new (rule 18: content as data, never ad-hoc writes). One entry per sighted invoice.
Each coding_note restates what the invoice face prints for that document (order, job or quote number, site, contract,
customer request number, service period and the priced lines) and states whether the printed PK equals the PK charged.
nature_category and theme_v3 are set per invoice: the TREESCAPE vendor template carries 'Contract mowing' by default,
because the one Treescape invoice sighted before this batch was the Q1GSL21074 mowing claim, and every Treescape
document here is street tree planting, maintenance or removal under project codes 20579, 20580 and 23760.
No amount here is inferred: every figure is the printed one, and the corpus gates GREEN with all 45 documents at TIE.
Sixteen of the batch's 45 documents carry a line on this register; the other 29 are dated before 1-Jul-2026 and sit on
the PS & WP register's earlier years (outside_trees_new_v6.json).
The nine legacy-letterhead Treescape documents carry an evid_note on identity: the vendor's own name is image-borne on that letterhead and only 'Australasia Pty Ltd' is in the text layer.

36101.coding_note: Contract Planting - Logan City Council - 20579, Logan Contract Planting - MAINTENANCE, 01.03.26 - 31.03.26; order 709807; our job no 205790101; contact Aaron Fritz; attention SAM FORBES. One printed line of $1,611.00 in the amount column, with a printed breakdown of fourteen street tree sites under it (Murrajong Road Springwood, Amy Drive Beenleigh, Mount Lindesay Highway Greenbank, Bella Vista Cct Edens Landing, Chay Street Shailer Park, City Road Beenleigh, Dendron and Mandew Streets Shailer Park, Lilygreen Court Springwood, Menora Road Bahrs Scrub, Ratz Park Mount Warren Park, Reading Street Logan Central, Springwood Rd Springwood, Summerview Avenue Yarrabilba, Towns Avenue Logan Village). THE PRINTED BREAKDOWN DOES NOT SUM TO THE PRINTED INVOICE AMOUNT: the fourteen site figures total $1,089.90 against the printed $1,611.00, a difference of $521.10 that the face does not explain. Printed subtotal $1,611.00 ex GST, GST $161.10, total $1,772.10; the invoice's own header arithmetic is correct and the charge ties the ledger line. The face also prints the cost account three ways on the same page: PK000057, PK00057 (five digits, Bella Vista Cct) and PK#000057 (Menora Road). Printed PK000057 matches the PK charged (PK000057).
36101.follow_up: Ask Treescape to reconcile the $521.10 between the fourteen printed site figures ($1,089.90) and the printed invoice amount ($1,611.00) on invoice 36101, and to print one consistent PK format. Amount paid is not in question; what each site was charged is.
36101.evid_note: Identity on this letterhead: the word 'Treescape' is printed as an image and the text layer carries only 'Australasia Pty Ltd', so the green block records that as the printed vendor (prep R7 withdrew the fuller name the extraction asserted; the claim is retained in the corpus as supplier_as_supplied). The printed ABN 20 117 830 118 is in the text layer and decides identity (rule 8), and the register label comes from the APLEDGER TRE010 history, not from the document.

7721.coding_note: Kachel Cleaning, 'Claim for Fuel levy August 2026'; purchase order 709779; the only printed detail under the claim is PK000515 and the figure. One printed line of $1,650.00. Printed subtotal $1,650.00 ex GST, GST $165.00, total $1,815.00. Printed PK000515 matches the PK charged (PK000515). TWO THINGS SIT ON THIS DOCUMENT. First, the levy cannot be tested against the Council stepped and capped fuel levy model: the face prints no work value, no fuel component percentage, no fuel escalation percentage and no diesel band, so there is nothing on it to recompute from. Second, invoice 7715 (31-Jul-2026, batch mix22, already sighted) claims the same $1,650.00 on the same PK000515 for 'Fuel levy from April to June 2026', a three month period, where this one claims $1,650.00 for the single month of August 2026. The charge sits on 73121 Cleaning & Sanitary, the same account the existing fuel levy coding open item was raised on.
7721.follow_up: Ask Kachel for the calculation behind the $1,650.00 fuel levy, and for the period each levy claim covers: 7715 charges $1,650.00 for April to June 2026 and 7721 charges $1,650.00 for August 2026 alone. Confirm with Finance whether a contract fuel levy belongs on 73121 Cleaning & Sanitary or on 74189, where the Vinton levy lines were recoded.
